login.signUpSubheading: Spin up an account in 30 seconds.
login.toggleToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in

tagline.body: Extract <occupations>occupations</occupations>, <skills>skills</skills>, and <qualifications>qualifications</qualifications> from any job description — and link them to the European taxonomy in milliseconds.

usageChart.title: Classifications · 30 days
usageChart.emptyDescription: Run a classification from the Classifier page to see usage data here.

history.title: Classification history
history.intro: A record of every classification run on your account.

table.emptyDescription: Classifications appear here after you run the Classifier.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.intro: Choose the models that power your classifications. Settings apply to every API call and the in-app Classifier — existing batch jobs continue with their original config.

nel.label: NEL
nel.panelIntro: The embedding model that maps each detected span to its closest ESCO concept by vector similarity. Higher dimensions yield better recall on ambiguous terms; lower dimensions are faster and cheaper.

taxonomy.label: Taxonomy
taxonomy.panelIntro: The reference vocabulary entities are linked against. Newer ESCO releases expand coverage; older releases preserve compatibility with downstream pipelines that pin specific concept URIs.

saveBar.dirtyHelp: Will apply to API calls and Classifier runs once saved.
saveBar.savedHelp: Applies to all subsequent API calls.

toasts.saveError: Couldn't save configuration. Please try again.

unsavedGuard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsavedGuard.description: Leaving this page now will discard the changes you've made to your configuration.

errors.loadFailed: We couldn't load your configuration. Refresh to retry.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Keys authenticate programmatic access to the Classifier API. The plaintext value is shown once at creation — copy it somewhere safe before you leave the page.

createForm.maxReachedHelp: You've reached the limit of {{max}} keys. Revoke one to create another.

revealBanner.title: Copy your new key
revealBanner.description: This is the only time the plaintext value will be shown. Store it somewhere safe — you won't be able to see it again.

revokeModal.title: Revoke this key?
revokeModal.description: Calls authenticated with “{{label}}” will start failing immediately. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No API keys yet
empty.description: Create your first key to start authenticating programmatic calls to the Classifier API.

toasts.createError: Couldn't create the key. Please try again.
toasts.revokeError: Couldn't revoke the key. Please try again.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.intro: Paste a job description and we'll extract occupations, skills, and qualifications — each linked to its closest ESCO concept.

placeholder.idleTitle: Run a classification to see results
placeholder.idleHelp: Paste a job description on the left and click Classify.
placeholder.runningHelp: Extracting entities and linking to ESCO.

list.title: Pipelines
list.intro: Pipelines define the sequence of plugins used to classify text. Activate a pipeline to make it the default for all API calls and the in-app Classifier.

empty.title: No pipelines yet
empty.description: Your account has no pipelines. The default Tabiya pipeline will be used for all classifications.
